# Backline model licenses

## Electric guitar

- File: `electric-guitar-v1.glb`
- Source: [Innerscene 3D Parts Library](https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/solid-body-electric-guitar-76088e09)
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal, public domain dedication
- Download route: Innerscene library's model download endpoint
- The source listing identifies this as an original, unbranded electric guitar model in real-world scale.

The model is included in the application bundle so the instrument can be rendered offline. Its nominal size is approximately 0.330 × 0.093 × 1.010 m. These dimensions are for visualization and do not represent manufacturing tolerances or a certified product specification.
